meta.name: NPC follower cruise — migrated from sample.xosc
meta.description: V2XCarla sample scenario, re-expressed natively on SimForge. One NPC spawns at RFS spawn point #3 (78.9, -91.1) at rest, holds still for 1 s (xosc StartTrigger SimulationTimeCondition 1.0), then accelerates linearly to 12 m/s over 3 s (SpeedAction dynamics linear 3.0 s) and cruises for the remainder of the 30 s clip. The ego is external_control in the xosc — the drive session supplies it, so it is not authored here; the bridge's live session attaches exactly as ScenarioRunner did. Weather ClearNoon maps to clear/noon; the 30 s storyboard StopTrigger becomes clipSeconds.
meta.author: v2x-scenario-migration
